judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a single failing acceptance test, a minimal spec stub, and a `.lore/dod.md` file. It made zero changes to `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or `package.json`, meaning tool input validation was not implemented at all and the test it added will fail. Additionally, the test was placed in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` instead of the requested `registry.test.ts`, and all other acceptance criteria (caching, dynamic schemas, redaction, orchestrator integration tests, documentation, and changelog updates) were completely omitted.
